overview: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: whole-level art direction reference for a playable Unreal Engine 5 cute fixed top-down calico cat game. Primary request: a mysterious dark crystal cave interior roughly 50m long by 30m wide, viewed as a beautiful high-angle orthographic cutaway game scene, NO roof obscuring paths. Cave runs from left entrance through two successive fork-and-rejoin passages to a large luminous crystal heart at right end. Broad winding slate paths, two irregular rock islands that create unmistakable choices, generous traversable corridors, low near-camera rock edges and taller layered crag walls behind. Ground is charcoal blue violet stone with rounded worn shelves and subtle cracks, very few tiny props. Large asymmetric chunky faceted cyan turquoise luminous crystal clusters light nearby floor and rocks with actual soft colored pools of light; second fork has lavender crystals for orientation. Dark spaces between light pools retain legible silhouettes. Cute block-bodied upright white/orange/black calico cat near first fork gives scale. Toy-like hand-painted anime background aesthetic, soft rounded rock bevels with broad fractured faces, deliberate restrained forms, high polish, gentle mist and glow, cinematic but readable. Full 50x30m level in one wide frame, clear route structure. No UI, no labels, no watermarks, no outdoor sky, no vegetation forest, no humans, no ceiling covering playable area.
